body: Overlap note: #964 (Fixes #906) also edits `liveMove` in fanuc-lathe.cps, in different hunks. The merge-tree is clean and #964's refusal sits before this cap. Whichever merges second re-runs lathe_post, lathe_post_refusals and c_axis_*, and re-checks #964's rated-bench "no warnings" assertion against this PR's capped F.

Refreshed with main (5bdfc00c): `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` (onLinear) and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` (onLinear, onCircular) conflicted on the motion guard - main changed `if (tw === null || inCycle) return;` to `if (tw === null || chainCut()) return;` (#1028/321df394: a cut inside a canned-cycle group is swallowed or refused by name, and seats the tool), and this PR added its rotary feed word right after that guard. Resolved as main's `chainCut()` guard followed by this PR's `feedWord(...)` / `if (fwd === null) return;` - the same composition git made on its own in fanuc onCircular, and main's `chainRapid()` plus this PR's `heldAngles` in onRapid merged cleanly. No refusal from either side dropped. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` stays main's 18 (no process change here).

Tests: the 64 post-touching app binaries (arc_planes, c_axis_*, conformance, doosan_dnm_post, drill_prior, drill_rplane, fanuc_post, fourth_axis_pose, heidenhain_cycles, inverted_*, lathe_*, machine_library, plasma_*, probe_*, program_*, rotary_feed_cap, rotary_verify, tilt, tormach_*, wear_comp, posting, ...) all green. `cargo test -p camcraft-post --no-fail-fast`: all green except `script_tormach_plasma` (8 stale `.refusal` goldens: "no machine is not declared" vs "no machine is stated, so none is declared") - it fails identically on 5bdfc00c itself, so it is main's, not this PR's. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean; app clippy on rotary_feed_cap / fourth_axis_pose clean (app's lib-test target doesn't compile on main: `rotary_law_tests.rs:27` lacks `Cutter.neck`). Mergeable: MERGEABLE. Ready for a re-check.
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).
Back to draft (M5): my quick pass readied this by mistake. It's held for the user's PathPilot Hub run, and there's no hands-on result yet. It goes ready again once that run is recorded.

Merge-time refresh by the maintainer's session: merged main (8d4e54db0) into the branch, head now 81adfa351. Hand resolutions, all keep-both: fanuc.cps onLinear/onCircular and doosan-dnm.cps onLinear/onCircular (main's new spindleStopped() refusal, then this PR's feedWord() cap, so neither refusal is dropped), and post/mod.rs (pub mod rotary_cap beside pub mod units). One follow-up commit, fix(test): the rotary_feed_cap streams now state a spindle speed, because main now refuses a feed with the spindle stopped (#1359); assertions unchanged. Gate: cargo xtask gate quick - all post suites green; app suites green except rotary_feed_cap (fixed, now 5/5) and program_units no_shipped_post_takes_the_program_unit_from_the_machine_file, which fails on sinker-iso.cps reading machine.units, a file this PR does not touch (main's own interaction). clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings clean. Still a draft, held for the Hub run.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 81adfa3516432aa13b457c5d19824987151a3c42 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one blocker: in an inch program the capped feed word is posted in mm/min.

Reviewed as the draft stands (merge of main at current origin/main is clean, no conflicts, no process files, no new dependencies, no build.rs/.github changes).

**What looks good**
- The merge resolutions are right. In `fanuc.cps` and `doosan-dnm.cps`, `onLinear` and `onCircular` keep main's `chainCut()` and `spindleStopped(...)` refusals first, then `feedWord()`. Every path that was refused before is still refused first, and the new refusals only add (a feed block now returns without writing, never one that was refused now passing).
- The cap can only lower F: `rotaryFeedCap` only takes `Math.min` of `g`; `rotaryFeed` reports `capped` only when `g < f`; otherwise the original `fw(p.FeedRate)` is posted unchanged. An F that floors under 0.1 is refused by name, never dropped.
- `rotAt` is only updated from words actually written, after the block is written.
- `pub mod rotary_cap;` beside `pub mod units;`, the provenance line, the decision file and the 126-line module are in order; the fix(test) commit adds `PARAM SpindleSpeed` to the streams as intended.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all suites) | green |
| app `rotary_feed_cap` | 5 passed |
| app `fourth_axis_pose` | 9 passed |
| app `c_axis_unwind` / `c_axis_live` | 7 / 5 passed |
| app `post_unit_word`, `post_spindle_rule_all`, `post_cycle_feed_spindle`, `conformance`, `posting`, `recorded_post_streams` | 5, 5, 8, 7, 17, 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| app `program_units::no_shipped_post_takes_the_program_unit_from_the_machine_file` | red on main itself (#1382, sinker-iso.cps), not this PR |

**Requested before merge**
1. **Inch programs post the capped F in the wrong unit (25.4x too fast).** `rotaryFeedWord` (`crates/post/src/post/rotary_cap.rs`, last function) returns `"F" + <mm/min value>`, and `feedWord` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` returns it as is, bypassing `ff()`, which divides by 25.4 when `inch` is set. I posted the PR's own `STREAM` through `fanuc.cps` with the A-rate 1000 trunnion twice (a throwaway local probe, not committed):
   ```
   Units mm:   G01 X10.1 Y0 Z0 A30 F3.3     /  A60 F1000  /  G03 ... A70 F111.1
   Units inch: G01 X0.3976 Y0 Z0 A30 F3.3   /  A60 F1000  /  G03 ... A70 F111.1
   ```
   The inch run (G20, F in in/min) should read about F0.13, F39.37 and F4.37; as posted each is 25.4x the cap, so the stated rotary rate is exceeded by 25x, worse than the uncapped mm value. Fix: have the capped path format through the post's own unit (e.g. `rotaryFeedWord` takes the already-converted value and trims in the post's precision, or the post calls a `ff`-style helper with the floor), keep the floor-down rule so it never rounds up past the cap, and pin it with an inch case in `rotary_feed_cap.rs` for fanuc and doosan-dnm (mm and inch must post the same physical feed). The same unit question applies to the "under 0.1 mm/min" refusal threshold; judge it in mm before converting.
2. (smaller, same area) `feedWord` returns the uncapped word when `!has(p.A)`, so under G43.4 a record that turns only B or C posts uncapped though `rotaryFeed` is called with `["A","B","C"]`. If no shipped machine tilts about B or C this is only a note, but then the guard should say so or test the first letter that is present rather than A.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Changes posted G-code; the PR body still says it waits on a Hub run.
- `fourth_axis_pose.rs` `tilted()` now opens with a rapid; the assertions are unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the review blocker (head 8054397b0). rotaryFeedWord now takes the program's unit: in an inch program (postOptions.Units) fanuc.cps and doosan-dnm.cps post the capped F in in/min, floored to 0.01 so it never passes the cap. The under-0.1 mm/min refusal is still judged in mm first.

Test: rotary_feed_cap::a_capped_rotary_feed_is_posted_in_the_programs_unit posts the STREAM in mm and inch through both posts (inch shows A30 F0.13, A60 F39.37, arc F4.37) and checks they are the same physical feed. It fails on the previous head (inch F3.3) and passes now.

Results: rotary_feed_cap 6/6, fourth_axis_pose 9, c_axis_unwind 7, post_unit_word 5, other post binaries green, cargo test -p camcraft-post green, clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings clean. No golden changed. The review's smaller note 2 (B/C-only records) was not touched. Still a draft. Ready for a re-review.

Review items fixed on `issue/885-rotary-feed-cap`. The head is now bc5e9b00. The PR stays a draft until the Hub run.

**Fix commit: 35b6fed58**, then merge bc5e9b008. 8054397b0 also landed on the branch while I was working, and it fixes the same blocker. The merge keeps that commit's pin, and its band is widened by 0.1 % (see below). The merge keeps this branch's word function, for the reason given under item 1. upstream/main was merged in first (987a1fde7), with no conflicts.

1. **The inch F.** `rotaryFeedWord(v, inch)` now writes the word in the post's own unit, the same way `ff()` does:
   - mm: mm/min, floored to 0.1;
   - inch: in/min, floored to **0.001**.

   Both units floor and never round, so the posted feed never passes the cap. The "under 0.1 mm/min" refusal is judged once, in mm, before converting. 0.001 in/min (0.0254 mm/min) is finer than the mm step, so a cap of 0.1 mm/min or more never floors to zero in inch. The refusal is then the same in both units. With a 0.01 step, a cap between 0.1 and 0.254 mm/min would be refused only in inch, and the message would name the wrong limit.

   The inch post exposed a second error. The cap's linear length is now measured between the points **as posted**: `rotaryFeed` takes a new `step` argument, 0.001 mm or 0.0001 in. In inch the 0.1 mm move posts as X0.3937 -> X0.3976, which is 0.09906 mm. Capping on the unrounded 0.1 mm posted F0.131, and that drives A at about 1008 deg/min, past the stated 1000.

   Inch output with the A-rate 1000 trunnion:
   - `A30 F0.13`: exactly 1000 deg/min over the posted length;
   - `A60 F39.37`;
   - arc `A70 F4.377`;
   - `A69 F39.4`: 1 mm of Z posts as 0.0394 in = 1.00076 mm.

   The mm output is unchanged. That last line is why the merge widens the band in `a_capped_rotary_feed_is_posted_in_the_programs_unit` by 0.1 %: the inch move is 0.08 % longer, so A still runs at 1000 deg/min.

2. **B or C without A.** `feedWord` in fanuc.cps and doosan-dnm.cps now caps any record that carries A, B or C, not A alone. Today `tilt()` writes no rotary word on a record without A, so the old gate let nothing through uncapped. The wider gate keeps holding if `tilt()` changes. The decision file records this.

**Pins**, all in `crates/app/tests/rotary_feed_cap.rs`:
- `an_inch_program_posts_the_capped_feed_in_inch`, for fanuc and doosan-dnm. It reads the inch program back in mm and checks every A-turning feed block against the stated A rate and feedRateMax. It checks the exact inch words, and that each mm F and inch F give the same physical feed.
- `the_slow_feed_refusal_is_judged_in_mm_in_both_units`. At a 300 deg/min A rate, mm posts F1 and inch posts F0.039, with no refusal. At 10 deg/min, both units refuse by name.
- `a_feed_turning_c_alone_holds_the_stated_c_rate`, on an A/C trunnion. A is held while C turns 40 degrees over 0.1 mm, and the post writes `C40 F1.2`.
- `a_capped_rotary_feed_is_posted_in_the_programs_unit`, from 8054397b0, is kept.

**Mutations.** Each was applied by itself to the merged tree and then reverted:
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| fanuc.cps calls `rotaryFeedWord(r.feed)`, dropping the unit | 3 tests red |
| the same in doosan-dnm.cps | 3 tests red |
| inch word rounded instead of floored | `an_inch_program...` red (F4.378) |
| refusal judged after converting (`t >= 0.1` in the post's unit) | `the_slow_feed_refusal...` red |
| prelude ignores `inch` | 2 tests red |
| posted-length `step` dropped, fanuc or doosan | `an_inch_program...` red (A past 1000) |
| `C` dropped from the cap's letters, fanuc or doosan | `a_feed_turning_c_alone...` red |
| gate put back to `has(p.A)` alone | green, as expected: `tilt()` posts no rotary word without A, so this gate cannot be pinned through the posts |

**Gate on the merged tree (local, macOS):**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: green.
- app suites: rotary_feed_cap 9, fourth_axis_pose 9, c_axis_unwind 7, c_axis_live 5, post_unit_word 5, program_units 7, post_spindle_rule_all 5, post_cycle_feed_spindle 8, conformance 7, posting 17, recorded_post_streams 5. All pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Not exercised:** a real control and the Hub simulation. Inch output was checked only through the engine.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8054397b056e58eafe4f4e78f05524220a6150ea -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge once the PathPilot Hub hold clears.** The earlier blocker is fixed. The PR stays a draft and the Hub-run hold still stands. I did not flag it ready or merge it.

**Delta since 81adfa35 (read in full)**
- `rotaryFeedWord(v, inch)` (`crates/post/src/post/rotary_cap.rs`) floors the value in the program's unit: 0.1 mm/min, or 0.01 in/min. Rounding never rises past the cap. The `inch` argument is passed from `fanuc.cps` and `doosan-dnm.cps`.
- `inch` is set from `postOptions.Units` only (`fanuc.cps:560`), never from the machine file.
- The "under 0.1 mm/min" refusal is judged in mm before conversion, so it fires for both units. A word that floors to nothing in the unit is refused as well.
- `spindleStopped()` still runs before `feedWord` at every call site (`fanuc.cps:658` and `:672`, `doosan-dnm.cps:787` and `:806`).
- There is no G93 or inverse-time path in either post or in the cap code, so nothing is converted twice. An uncapped feed still goes through `fw()`, and a capped one converts once.
- No golden or snapshot file is in the PR diff.

**Local results (trial-merged with current origin/main, clean merge)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `rotary_feed_cap` | 6 passed |
| `fourth_axis_pose` | 9 passed |
| `c_axis_unwind` | 7 passed |
| `post_unit_word` | 5 passed |
| `program_units` | 7 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` | all passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Mutation check:** I put the call back to `rotaryFeedWord(r.feed)` in both posts. `a_capped_rotary_feed_is_posted_in_the_programs_unit` then fails ("mm F3.3 posted as inch F3.3"). I restored the files afterwards.

**Requested before merge:** nothing.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The earlier note about B/C-only records is not blocking. `feedWord` returns the op's F when a record has no A word, and an unstated rotary rate caps nothing. That is the behaviour this PR documents, and the delta does not change it. A follow-up issue is fine if you want B/C-only moves capped too.
- The 1e-9 guard in the floor can pass the cap by about 1e-9 in/min before it is written out at 0.01 resolution. That is harmless.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
